2026_02_CLE_TB.headline: Cleveland’s interior protection meets a Tampa Bay front with a chance to dictate
2026_02_CLE_TB.paragraph1: Cleveland heads to Tampa without guard Teven Jenkins, while cornerback Tyson Campbell is questionable after returning to limited work Friday. The Buccaneers list Miles Killebrew, Jalen McMillan and Jacob Parrish as questionable, but several other contributors finished the week without game designations. Cleveland’s path is to establish the run and keep its protection from cracking inside; Tampa Bay can tilt the game by forcing the Browns into obvious passing situations and attacking weakened blocking combinations.
2026_02_CLE_TB.model_rationale: Cleveland’s ability to stay balanced despite an offensive-line absence, versus Tampa Bay’s capacity to create predictable passing downs, should shape the matchup’s offensive efficiency.
